title: "Using tsinferR with tskitR and tsdateR"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette

  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Using tsinferR with tskitR and tsdateR}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

The companion R packages operate on the standard `.trees` format. The
optional `tskitR` package can load and manipulate a tsinferR result, while
`tsdateR` can assign ages to its nodes. tsinferR's adapters bridge through a
temporary `.trees` file, so each package retains ownership of its own C
pointers.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
if (!requireNamespace("tskitR", quietly = TRUE) ||
    !requireNamespace("tsdateR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
}
library(tsinferR)
```

## Infer and exchange a tree sequence

```{r workflow}
vcf <- system.file("extdata", "example.vcf.gz", package = "tsinferR")
work <- file.path(tempdir(), "tsinferR-companions")
dir.create(work, showWarnings = FALSE)
samples <- vcf_to_vcz(vcf, file.path(work, "samples.vcz"), overwrite = TRUE)
cfg <- tsinfer_config(
  sources = list(tsinfer_source(samples, "samples")),
  ancestral_state = ancestral_state(samples, is_reference = TRUE),
  ancestors = list(ancestors_config("ancestors", file.path(work, "ancestors.vcz"), "samples")),
  match = match_config(sources = list(
    ancestors = match_source_config(node_flags = 0, create_individuals = FALSE),
    samples = match_source_config()
  )),
  post_process = post_process_config()
)
ts <- run_tsinfer(cfg)
```

Convert to a `tskitR` `TreeSequence`, use its methods, then convert back:

```{r tskit}
r_ts <- as_tskit(ts)
r_ts$num_trees
r_ts$diversity()
ts_roundtrip <- as_tsinfer(r_ts)
ts_equals(ts, ts_roundtrip)
```

## Date with tsdateR

`date_tsinfer()` invokes `tsdateR::date_ts()` on the standard file and returns
the dated sequence as a new `tsinfer_ts`:

```{r tsdate}
dated <- date_tsinfer(ts, mutation_rate = 1e-8)
head(ts_nodes(dated))
```

For direct control, the same file boundary can be used explicitly:

```{r direct}
path <- file.path(work, "inferred.trees")
ts_dump(ts, path)
t_to_date <- tsdateR::ts_load(path)
dated_by_tsdateR <- tsdateR::date_ts(t_to_date, mutation_rate = 1e-8)
tsdateR::ts_summary(dated_by_tsdateR)
```

```{r cleanup, include=FALSE}
unlink(work, recursive = TRUE)
```
